theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V δ : ℝ) (η : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (η k)) → (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (η k)) → (∀ k z, 0 ≤ η k z) → (∀ k z, η k (-z) = η k z) → (∀ k, ∫ z, η k z = 1) → (∀ k, support (η k) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) δ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂volume, Tendsto (fun k => (convolution (η k) (Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x) atTop (𝓝 ((Set.indicator {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} u) x))) → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |u x - u y| ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 - 2 * δ) * (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * V
